lines.text: The LORD calls the thirsty to come to the waters, and those without money to come, buy, and eat.
The LORD promises an everlasting covenant, with loving devotion promised to Moses, a witness to the nations.
The wicked man is told to forsake his way and return to the LORD, who will freely pardon.
The LORD says His ways and thoughts are higher than ours, as the heavens are higher than the sea.
The mountains and hills will burst into song, and instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow.
